feeds.title: Independent Church of God of Atlanta
feeds.description: Independent Church of God of Atlanta is a sabbath-keeping Christian fellowship. ICGA is committed to maintaining our weekly Sabbath observance. We have installed high-quality UV filters on our HVAC systems. We also provide a zoom link for anyone who would like to attend virtually.

feeds.title: Glen Mar Church Blog
feeds.description: Glen Mar Church is a United Methodist community in Ellicott City, MD, committed to praising God, growing disciples, and serving the world. Our vision is to be a church that roots people into the life-giving message of Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: The Church Of God
feeds.description: The Church of God is the global, growing Body of Christ with members united by the covenant to walk in the light of God's Word. We exist to glorify God by making disciples who will spread the message of Christ and His Church to every nation on Earth to lay the foundation for future generations to do the same until the time of Christ's return!

feeds.title: Church Of God Blog
feeds.description: Church Of God is a place where salvation makes you a member! We are a group of the Church of God Reformation Movement and we have a common goal of all Church of God people: to live a holy and righteous life to the glory of God. We place great value upon the Bible as the only answer to the questions of faith. It is our statement of faith.

feeds.title: Church Of God International Toronto Blog
feeds.description: Preaching the gospel of Jesus Christ to all nations in the Greater Toronto Area. While we acknowledge that God has blessed us with a rich understanding of His word, we don't believe we know everything. We are continually striving to grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Church of God, International is nondenominational. Our beliefs are based on the Bible.

feeds.title: Church Of God World Missions News
feeds.description: Church of God World Missions seeks to fulfill the Great Commission of our Lord Jesus Christ to 'Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit. Our mission is that seek to win the lost; disciple believers; develop Christian leaders; and care for the poor, the homeless, and the needy.

feeds.title: Church of God Sabbath Day Blog
feeds.description: We of the Church of God, Sabbath Day, in no way claim this endeavor for ourselves. We submit this endeavor to you, the curious, the seeking, and the humble student of God's word. Our desire is to help both you and ourselves go beyond being believers in being disciples of our Lord and Savior.

feeds.title: Church Of God Perspective Blog
feeds.description: Church Of God Perspective believes in looking forward to the Kingdom of God! On our blog page, you can go through posts like can you handle freedom, place of physics, forgiveness & the pass over, facing the truth about politics and many more.

feeds.title: Church Of God Ministries Blog
feeds.description: Church Of God ministry newsletter keeps the movement up to date and informed with changes, news, and tools for minister support. The Church of God is a global movement of people seeking to fulfill God's mission in the world. We're committed to studying the Word of God and faithfully living it out. We're committed to the mission that Jesus Christ gave every believer: to make disciples of all nations.

feeds.title: The Church Of God Articles
feeds.description: The Church Of God is the church of the living god! The articles posted on the Church of God page are on topics like hard sayings, the primacy of preaching, big tech censorship, the sacredness of life, rejecting the new normal, and more!

feeds.title: Hillside Church Of God Blog
feeds.description: Hillside Church of God is a Bible-teaching, non-denominational Christian fellowship affiliated with the Church of God. Our mission is to worship Jesus Christ as Lord, to proclaim Him as our Lord and Savior, and to show the love of God through Jesus Christ to all persons, making disciples and equipping them for service.

feeds.title: Church Of God Network Blog
feeds.description: Church Of God Network is a nonprofit organization that works solely to build community within the Church of God and advocate for actions and attitudes that further that purpose. Our mission is to help build community within the Church of God by facilitating connection, encouraging conversations, and giving back.

feeds.title: Northern New England Church of God Blog
feeds.description: Sonja and I would like to welcome you to the online presence of the Church of God in Northern New England. We are affiliated with the Church of God International Offices. We are unapologetically Trinitarian Pentecostal, evangelical, theologically conservative, and committed to finishing the Great Commission. You will not only see that we are an active movement, but that our values and goals to represent Jesus Christ and engage in his mission will be quite evident.

feeds.title: Church of God International
feeds.description: The Church of God International (CGI) traces its origins to the Church that Jesus founded in the early first century. Our mission is to preach the Gospel of Jesus Christ throughout the world. We are blessed with four basic tools to accomplish this: Personal and local church evangelism. Television broadcasting.

feeds.title: Brooklyn Church Of God Blog
feeds.description: Brooklyn Church Of God Blog is a blog page by Pastor Rodney Walker. Each week, you will find brief insights on this blog page into Pastor Rodney's upcoming Sunday message. After each Sunday service, visit this blog again to view the same post, updated with a video of our worship time.

feeds.title: Mountain Valley Church Of God » Blog
feeds.description: Here on The Church of God Mountain Valley, you'll find informative articles on abiding in love by walking on obedience, knowing god is keeping his commandments, and more! Church Of God is a global movement of people seeking to fulfill God's mission in the world. We're committed to studying the Word of God and faithfully living it out. We're committed to the mission that Jesus Christ gave every believer: to make disciples of all nations.

feeds.title: Marceline Church Of God Seventh Day Blog
feeds.description: Marceline Church Of God Seventh Day is a community of believers learning to trust God and share his love with Marceline and the surrounding area. Our blog section explores subjects like the memory verse for the week, the brevity of life, whether we're a saint or not, and many more!

feeds.title: Christian Church Of God Blog
feeds.description: We are a Sabbath-observing congregation holding to the traditional 'Faith Once Delivered to the Early New Testament Church. The Christian Church of God, Grand Junction, Colorado, is an independent New Testament congregation. We extend the right hand of fellowship to all believers who genuinely seek to follow God's commandments and strive to develop the character of the living Christ.

feeds.title: Summer Of God Church Blog
feeds.description: Summer of God is a church passionate about life change. We believe that Jesus Christ is the only begotten Son of the Father, conceived of the Holy Ghost, and born of the Virgin Mary. Our mission is the vision of hope. We seek to evangelize and equip people with the gospel of Jesus Christ, in spirit and truth, for the glory of God.

feeds.title: Church Of God The Fathers Call » Blog
feeds.description: The Blog section of Church of God The Father's Call informs about heart and soul, being tender-hearted, seeking suspicion, the perils of being in spiritual denial, and many more! The Church of God, through this website, seeks to support those whom the Father calls to come into a restored relationship with Himself through His Son, Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: Church of God International United Kingdom Blog
feeds.description: The Church of God International follows the same teachings, doctrines, and practices established then. Our commission is to proclaim the gospel of the coming Kingdom of God to all the world as a witness and teach all nations to observe what Christ commanded. Our mission is to preach the gospel of Jesus Christ and the Kingdom of God in all the world, make disciples in all nations and care for them.

feeds.title: Wazeecha Church Blog
feeds.description: At Wazeecha Church we believe that everyone deserves a good New Testament church. Churches exist as an onramp for people to connect to God and if churches get in the way of that basic mission, something is terribly wrong. Church at Wazeecha's mission is to live the great commission and great commandment.

feeds.title: Kinnaird Church Of God Pastor's Blog
feeds.description: Kinnaird Church Of God Pastor's Blog informs about directed paths and appointments, prejudice to acceptance, and many more! Kinnaird Church of God is a growing group of believers who are committed to 'doing life' together; enjoying community and building each other up as we learn to walk with Jesus and grow deeper in our knowledge and love for Him.

feeds.title: Church Of God In Christ News
feeds.description: The Church of God in Christ, Inc. is a Christian organization in the Holiness-Pentecostal tradition. It is the largest Pentecostal denomination in the United States. We believe that the Bible is the Word of God and contains one harmonious and sufficiently complete system of doctrine. Our mission is to seek and save that which is lost.

feeds.title: The Hebrew Church Of God Blog
feeds.description: The Hebrew Church of God exists to glorify God and advance his Kingdom. Therefore we are dedicated to the cause of inter-denominational and worldwide evangelism. These words express our heart our spirit and our focus. Our Mission call is to preach Jesus Christ, God's Son as the Saviour, Healer, and Baptizer, with the Holy Spirit and soon coming King.

feeds.title: United Church Of God Blog
feeds.description: United Church Of God Blog is all about posts on god and its existence like online bible discussions, God's world still works, beauty in chaos, defending your faith, and more! The mission of the United Church of God is to proclaim to the world the good news of the coming Kingdom of God.
